model.readout: sigmoid(linear(mean_k(full encoder(rot90_k RGB)))); full semantic neck retained

training.learning_rate: attempt i maps to virtual epoch1+floor(i*60/17430); use v16 two-phase cosine at that virtual epoch

checkpoint_selection: earliest minimum direct scalar NMAE on complete source1506 within15 orbit epochs
external_checkpoint: source-selected best only after all15 orbit epochs complete; no incumbent alias
inference_input: native ROI RGB, linear resize256, ImageNet normalization, fixed C4 tensor orbit and semantic mean; no GT geometry or target scalar input

orbit.input_order: k-major concatenation of rotated original RGB tensors
orbit.rotation: torch.rot90 on spatial dimensions before the encoder; no interpolation or reflection
orbit.pooling: float32 arithmetic mean of four semantic vectors before the linear scalar logit
orbit.label: one unchanged physical scalar per original ROI

comparison.BN_training_batch: 16 original ROIs with4 correlated orientations each; not64 independent ROIs
